thread:
elaine: Heads-up: did a quick pass on the playground run history. The long tool-call rows are getting noisy for screen readers. Open to suggestions for a cleaner SR experience.

mike: +1. Right now SR reads the entire arg blob which is overkill. Maybe collapse to a short summary row and provide an explicit "show details" control that expands.

sam: Agreed. Also we should stop repeating timestamps in the label; ATs already announce time. Short label like 'Tool call: <name> — <one-line summary>' would be better.

nisha: Prototype aria-label we tested: `Tool call by {actor}: {toolName} — {briefResult}`. Detailed args live in a region with aria-labelledby linking back. That way SR users get context without the full JSON dump.

jordan: Can you paste the exact sample so I can test with VoiceOver?

nisha: Sure: ```aria-label=\"Tool call by Elaine: fetch_weather — returned: 'sunny, 72F'\"```

mike: That looks much cleaner. One more: when there are multiple outputs, the button copy should indicate count. Instead of "Show tool output" use "Show outputs (3)" or similar.

elaine: Good call. Also the signature pill in run rows wraps long type lists and pushes everything down. We should truncate with ellipses and show a tooltip/aria-describedby with the full signature.

sam: On the schema editor side, inline-editing params currently flashes the entire JSON to SR. We should present the common fields as labeled form controls (Name, Description, Param count) and have a separate "View full schema" dialog for raw JSON. That keeps quick edits accessible.

jordan: For the dialog remember: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, focus trap, close on escape, and ensure heading is the first focusable element for screen readers. I'll run NVDA/VO checks once implemented.

aria-bot: Accessibility smoke run scheduled for staging after the patch (PR #3428).

devops-bot: Deploy to staging initiated by @sam  build 2025.01.4 (ci-9099)

elaine: Plan: land the aria-label + outputs count + signature truncation patch this week. Editor refactor next sprint. Sam will open the copy + a11y test PRs. Jordan to validate on mac/win.

sam: Filing the small PRs now. Will add a test case that asserts aria-label shape and that the detail region has aria-labelledby.

jordan: Will report back with any SR edge cases after smoke runs.

elaine: Thanks all. I'll add the examples and the suggested labels to the design ticket and link the staging build. If the bots report failures, drop logs here. :slightly_smiling_face:
